nodes.name: delete_file.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the `delete_file` agent tool that removes a single file within the sandboxed session workspace, honoring the live workspace root and optional ActionRouter routing.

nodes.name: DeleteFileTool
nodes.summary: Tool struct implementing `delete_file`, resolving the construction-time or live sandbox root before removing a file, with optional ActionRouter routing.

nodes.name: parameters
nodes.summary: Builds the JSON schema for delete_file's `path` parameter.

nodes.name: execute_text
nodes.summary: Main entry point for delete_file: resolves the sandbox root, validates the path is inside it, and removes the file (or routes through ActionRouter).

nodes.name: list_dir.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the `list_dir` agent tool that lists files and directories under a given path within the sandboxed workspace.

nodes.name: ListDirTool
nodes.summary: Tool struct implementing `list_dir`, resolving the construction-time or live sandbox root before listing directory contents, with optional ActionRouter routing.

nodes.name: parameters
nodes.summary: Builds the JSON schema for list_dir's `path` parameter.

nodes.name: execute_text
nodes.summary: Main entry point for list_dir: resolves the sandbox root, validates the path, and returns a formatted directory listing (or routes through ActionRouter).

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module for the filesystem tool group (`read_file`, `list_dir`, `delete_file`, `write_env_file`) plus shared sandbox-root resolution helpers used by all of them.

nodes.name: allowed_roots
nodes.summary: Combines the static allowed directories with any workspace-state-derived roots into the full set of sandbox roots a filesystem tool may access.

nodes.name: live_allowed_dir
nodes.summary: Resolves the currently-live allowed directory for a filesystem tool, preferring workspace_state's working_dir() over the construction-time restricted root, falling back to the provided default.

nodes.name: write_env_file.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the privileged `write_env_file` tool, the sole consumer that resolves `{{secret:<token>}}` placeholders from the secret broker into plaintext and writes them securely to a `.env`-style file with git-tracking and permission guardrails.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `Zeroizing<String>` buffers to scrub decrypted secret plaintext from memory immediately after use.

nodes.name: WriteEnvFileTool
nodes.summary: Tool struct implementing `write_env_file`, wiring workspace state, scratchpad directory, and the secret broker needed to resolve and securely write `.env`-style files.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a WriteEnvFileTool wired with workspace state, scratchpad directory, and the secret broker.

nodes.name: description
nodes.summary: Returns the human-readable tool description for write_env_file surfaced to the LLM.

nodes.name: parameters
nodes.summary: Builds the JSON schema for write_env_file's path/body parameters.

nodes.name: execute_text
nodes.summary: Main entry point for write_env_file: validates the target path, substitutes secret placeholders into plaintext, and writes the file securely with zeroized cleanup.

nodes.name: substitute_secrets
nodes.summary: Resolves `{{secret:<token>}}` placeholders in the file body via the secret broker, materializing plaintext into a zeroizing buffer.

nodes.name: ensure_dotenv_basename
nodes.summary: Validates that the target path's basename matches the `.env`-style naming convention this tool is restricted to.

nodes.name: is_git_tracked
nodes.summary: Checks whether a target env file is tracked by git, used to warn against committing secrets.

nodes.name: write_file_secure
nodes.summary: Writes file content to disk with restrictive permissions so secret-bearing env files aren't world-readable.

nodes.name: inspect_terminals.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the `inspect_terminals` tool giving the agent bounded read/write/close access to orgii-managed PTY sessions for terminal inspection and control.

nodes.name: InspectTerminalsTool
nodes.summary: Tool struct implementing `inspect_terminals`, holding the shared PtySessions map used to inspect, write to, and close orgii-managed terminal sessions.

nodes.name: info_from_session
nodes.summary: Builds a TerminalOutputSnapshot describing a PTY session's current output and metadata for the tool response.

nodes.name: execute_text
nodes.summary: Main entry point for inspect_terminals: dispatches read/write/close actions against the requested PTY session id.

nodes.name: manage_file_history.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the `manage_file_history` tool that lets the agent list, rewind, and redo file-history snapshots for the current session, invalidating CLI resume state on mutation.

nodes.name: ManageFileHistoryTool
nodes.summary: Tool struct implementing `manage_file_history`, tracking the current session id used to scope list/rewind/redo operations over file-history snapshots.

nodes.name: review_session_ids
nodes.summary: Resolves the set of session ids whose file-history snapshots should be considered for a review/rewind operation.

nodes.name: invalidate_cli_resume_state_best_effort
nodes.summary: Best-effort invalidation of any external CLI resume state after a file-history mutation, so stale resume points aren't offered.

nodes.name: description
nodes.summary: Returns the human-readable tool description for manage_file_history surfaced to the LLM.

nodes.name: parameters
nodes.summary: Builds the JSON schema for manage_file_history's action/message-id parameters.

nodes.name: execute_text
nodes.summary: Dispatches a manage_file_history call to the list/rewind/redo implementation based on the `action` parameter.

nodes.name: exec_list
nodes.summary: Lists all file-history snapshots for the session with their file counts.

nodes.name: exec_rewind
nodes.summary: Restores tracked files to the state they were in before a given message, recording a redo snapshot first.

nodes.name: exec_redo
nodes.summary: Re-applies the most recent rewind by restoring files from the redo snapshot, if one exists.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the `manage_lsp` tool exposing language-server inspection, install/uninstall command retrieval, enable/disable, and start/stop controls to the coding agent without executing package-manager commands directly.

nodes.name: ManageLspTool
nodes.summary: Tool struct implementing `manage_lsp`, wiring the LSP manager, Tauri app handle, and workspace root needed to inspect and control language servers.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a ManageLspTool wired with the LSP manager, Tauri app handle, and workspace root.

nodes.name: find_language_info
nodes.summary: Looks up a language server's supported-language metadata by normalized language name.

nodes.name: execute_list
nodes.summary: Implements the `list` action, enumerating all managed language servers with their install/enabled status.

nodes.name: execute_running
nodes.summary: Implements the `running` action, listing currently-running language server processes.

nodes.name: execute_status
nodes.summary: Implements the `status` action, returning detailed install/running/enabled status for one language.

nodes.name: execute_install_command
nodes.summary: Implements the `install_command` action, returning the shell command the agent should run via run_shell to install a language server.

nodes.name: execute_uninstall_command
nodes.summary: Implements the `uninstall_command` action, returning the shell command to uninstall a language server.

nodes.name: execute_set_enabled
nodes.summary: Implements the `set_enabled` action, toggling whether a language server is enabled for the current workspace.

nodes.name: execute_start
nodes.summary: Implements the `start` action, launching a language server process for the given language.

nodes.name: execute_stop
nodes.summary: Implements the `stop` action, terminating a running language server process for the given language.

nodes.name: description
nodes.summary: Returns the human-readable tool description for manage_lsp surfaced to the LLM.

nodes.name: parameters
nodes.summary: Builds the JSON schema for manage_lsp's action/language parameters.

nodes.name: execute_text
nodes.summary: Dispatches a manage_lsp call to the list/running/status/install/uninstall/set_enabled/start/stop implementation based on the `action` parameter.

nodes.name: normalize_language
nodes.summary: Normalizes a language name/alias (e.g. `ts`, `js`) to its canonical form used throughout the LSP subsystem.

nodes.name: validate_supported_language
nodes.summary: Validates that a normalized language name is one of the LSP subsystem's supported languages, returning a descriptive error otherwise.

nodes.name: tests.rs
nodes.summary: Unit tests for manage_lsp's language-alias normalization, workspace enable/disable checks, default-path resolution, and server-id canonicalization.

nodes.name: is_language_enabled_in_workspace_uses_disabled_list
nodes.summary: Verifies that a language is treated as disabled when present in the workspace's disabled-languages list.

nodes.name: resolve_path_or_default_uses_default_when_missing
nodes.summary: Verifies that resolve_path_or_default falls back to the default path when no explicit path is supplied.
